newsitem.title: UK: Bunzl to sell paper units for 61.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Bunzl to sell paper units for 61.6 mln stg.

text.p: UK paper and plastics firm Bunzl Plc said on Tuesday that it would sell its German and Italian fine paper businesses for a total sum of 61.6 million stg.
Bunzl said it was selling Wilhelm Seiler Gmbh and Nunzl Italia SpA to Dutch firm NV Koninklijke KNP BT.
About 57.6 million stg would be payable in cash upon completion of the agreement while about four million stg of external borrowings of the companies would be assumed by KNP BT.
The disposal is conditional on clearance under EU merger regulations for which an application would be submitted shortly, Bunzl said in a statement.
It said the sale proceeds would be used to reduce borrowings. Chairman Anthony Habgood said the company was committed to its fine paper activities in the UK and Ireland.
